items.title: AI’s Vulnerability Surge May Be More Manageable Than First Feared
items.description: New research suggests the coming Vulnpocalypse may not be so overwhelming for enterprise security teams — if they have the right strategies.

items.title: Hackers exploit Sangoma Switchvox flaw to deploy reverse shells
items.description: Attackers are actively exploiting CVE-2026-9586, an unauthenticated SQL injection vulnerability in the Sangoma Switchvox VoIP platform that can lead to remote code execution. [...]

items.title: SonicWall SMA 1000 Zero-Days Enable Unauthenticated RCE
items.description: The exploitation activity follows attacks earlier this summer on two other zero-day vulnerabilities in the vendor's edge devices.

items.title: AI Gives Cybercriminals a Dangerous Time Advantage
items.description: Former cybercriminal Brett Johnson provides a look inside the mind of a threat actor and discusses where AI provides the most value for attackers.

items.title: OpenLeash Adds a Human Check to Risky AI Agent Actions
items.description: The security tool intercepts potentially dangerous agent actions, blocking clear threats and requesting human approval when intent is uncertain. The post OpenLeash Adds a Human Check to Risky AI Agent Actions appeared first on SecurityWeek.

items.title: WordPress backup plugin flaw exposes millions of sites to takeover attacks
items.description: An SQL injection vulnerability in the All-in-One WP Migration and Backup plugin for WordPress could allow unauthenticated attackers to execute remote code and take control of affected websites. [...]

items.description: Google on Wednesday announced Gemini 3.8 Flash Cyber, which it described as its most capable cybersecurity model, and has made it available to a set of trusted defenders via a new initiative called the Fairwind Program. items.title: Threat Gang 'Springs' Vishing Attacks on Microsoft Teams Users
items.description: The "Spring Ring" operation aims to compromise users of the collaboration suite to remotely access their sessions, spread malware, and even take over infrastructure.

items.title: Fake Software Installers Disable Windows Update and Weaken Microsoft Defender
items.description: An active malware campaign is using bogus software-download websites to impersonate trusted vendors and distribute malicious installers. items.title: Hackers exploit critical JFrog Artifactory flaw to forge admin tokens
items.description: A critical authentication bypass vulnerability (CVE-2026-82329) in JFrog Artifactory is being exploited in attacks to create tokens that provide administrative access. [...]

items.title: UK Moves to Block High-Risk Tech Suppliers From Critical Infrastructure
items.description: Late amendments to the Cyber Security and Resilience Bill would give ministers new powers to restrict risky technology providers as supply chain attacks intensify. The post UK Moves to Block High-Risk Tech Suppliers From Critical Infrastructure appeared first on SecurityWeek.

items.title: Malicious .git Configs Can Make Claude, Codex, Cursor, and Other AI Agents Run Attacker Code
items.description: Manifold Security has disclosed eight security flaws across seven command-line AI coding agents in which a repository's own Git configuration names a command that the agent runs on the developer's machine, four of them still unpatched at publication. items.title: Ransomware protection for MSPs: A 6-point checklist for faster recovery
items.description: Ransomware resilience requires more than backups or endpoint detection alone. Acronis outlines six capabilities MSPs should test across client environments, from reducing exposure and detecting attacks to preserving recovery points and restoring operations quickly. [...]

items.title: Malicious Apache Modules Hijack Brazilian Government Site Traffic to Push Betting Pages
items.description: A Chinese-speaking cybercrime cluster known as Gambling Goblin has been observed installing malicious Apache modules on compromised web servers run by Brazilian government and educational institutions, and using them to divert visitors to attacker-controlled pages promoting online gambling and sports betting. Check Point Research said it has tracked the campaign since mid-2025. The modules

items.title: BGP Hijack Delivers Malicious Virtualizor Update That Establishes Persistent Root Access
items.description: Virtualizor said hackers used a Border Gateway Protocol (BGP) hijack to divert Softaculous traffic. The hackers then used the diverted update traffic to deliver a malicious Virtualizor package to some installations. A hosting-provider account separately said 5 of its 34 checked Virtualizor hypervisors sustained root-level compromise. The incident window ran from approximately August 28 at 20:57

items.title: Rockwell Automation Patches Over a Dozen Vulnerabilities Across Products
items.description: The industrial giant has released advisories for its RSLinx Classic, ArmorStart, ControlFLASH, FactoryTalk, and other products. The post Rockwell Automation Patches Over a Dozen Vulnerabilities Across Products appeared first on SecurityWeek.

items.title: Dropbox accounts breached through Lenovo email verification flaw
items.description: Dropbox is warning some users that an unauthorized party accessed their accounts by exploiting a flaw in Lenovo's email verification process to register fraudulent Lenovo IDs. [...]

items.title: Exploit Published for Fresh Cleo Harmony Vulnerability
items.description: The security defect allows remote attackers to bypass authentication through argument bearer manipulation. The post Exploit Published for Fresh Cleo Harmony Vulnerability appeared first on SecurityWeek.

items.title: Anthropic Details Response to Security Incidents, Unveils Enterprise Safeguards
items.description: Anthropic introduced Enterprise Frontier Safeguards (EFS), a system that combines zero data retention with automated monitoring for misuse. The post Anthropic Details Response to Security Incidents, Unveils Enterprise Safeguards appeared first on SecurityWeek.

items.title: Student Loan Breach Exposes 2.5M Records
items.description: 2.5 million people were affected, in a breach that could spell more trouble down the line.

items.title: Watering Hole Attacks Push ScanBox Keylogger
items.description: Researchers uncover a watering hole attack likely carried out by APT TA423, which attempts to plant the ScanBox JavaScript-based reconnaissance tool.
